oldest_core_1_client_current_runtime.rule: Every future runtime_1 build must continue to run this compiled client without recompilation.

current_client_prior_stable_runtime.reason: No prior stable Core 1.x runtime exists before the initial 1.0 declaration.
current_client_prior_stable_runtime.future_rule: Beginning with the first post-1.0 runtime_1 release, retain the preceding stable runtime and run the then-current client against it.

historical_candidate_policy: PB.2-PB.6 binaries remain immutable pre-release evidence and carry no Stable compatibility promise. They are not aliases for Core 1.0.
